trial_court: Court of Mr. Mukesh Kumar Gupta, District Judge (Commercial Court)-07, Central District, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi, CS (Comm.) No.462/2022
facts_of_case: The plaintiff bank sought recovery of Rs.3,00,974/- alongwith interest thereon @ 24% per annum from the date of filing of the suit till its realization.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the plaintiff to prove that the defendant has failed to comply with the terms and conditions of the loan agreement.
legal_principles.held: Since none appeared on behalf of the defendant during the course of proceedings, the defendant was proceeded against ex parte vide order dated 27.02.2024.

legal_principles.principle: A party's failure to file a written statement within the statutory period can result in forfeiture of their right to file a written statement.
legal_principles.held: Since, the defendant failed to file the Written Statement within the statutory period, his right to file the Written Statement was forfeited vide order dated 02.11.2023 of the Ld. Predecessor of the court.

outcome.final_order: The plaintiff bank was granted recovery of Rs.3,00,974/- alongwith interest thereon @ 24% per annum from the date of filing of the suit till its realization.

use_for_drafting: drafting a plaint for cheque bounce case
